Full summary: Superseded the disabledMcpjsonServers fix — it silently does nothing for plugin servers. Replaced with checked-in deniedMcpServers serverCommand deny in .claude/settings.json; verified plugin server no longer loads
Decisions: [object Object]
Findings: warning: disabledMcpjsonServers in Claude Code settings only governs project .mcp.json servers — it silently no-ops for plugin-bundled MCP servers; the working per-user mechanism is /mcp disable (persists to disabledMcpServers in ~/.claude.json project entry), the working committable mechanism is deniedMcpServers with serverCommand matching; claude mcp list ignores disabledMcpServers (still lists disabled servers as Connected) but does reflect deniedMcpServers (denied servers vanish from the list) — use it to verify deny-based blocks only; ~/.claude.json has duplicate project entries for this repo: /Users/dave/Code/twining-mcp (stale, capital C, holds an old posthog plugin disable) and /Users/dave/code/twining-mcp (live) — macOS case-insensitivity artifact worth cleaning up someday
summary: Superseded the disabledMcpjsonServers fix — it silently does nothing for plugin servers. Replaced with checked-in deniedMcpServers serverCommand deny in .claude/settings.json; verified plugin serve…
